correctness.rationale: Checked the repaired statement and proof with the original mathematical formulas unchanged. A flip changes exactly three terms even at N=3, so a strictly blocked word has at most one defect in every cyclic triple. Over F_2 the homogeneous relation gives b_{i+3}=b_i, hence a trivial kernel if 3 does not divide N and a two-dimensional kernel otherwise. In the latter case each of the three defect residue sums equals the total spin-bit sum; these are two independent compatibility constraints, hence sufficient by the kernel calculation. A cyclic admissible word corresponds to exactly one closed memory-state path (the all-plus word stays in the last state). On divisible lengths the four-term projector precisely cancels the fourfold spin preimage factor, and the three nontrivial weights are cyclic rotations of the signed three-step transfer block. This proves the blocked polynomial. Two physical defects at divisible lengths must be in a single residue class; their cyclic gaps are at least three, giving 4 times 3 binom(N/3,2) blocked first excitations for N>=6. The N=3 excited word is all minus and is not blocked. The unrestricted polynomial follows by dropping the local constraint, consistent with the cited prior transfer calculation. The characteristic polynomials u^3-u^2-1 and u^3-u-1 each have one real root greater than one; their two conjugate roots have modulus the inverse square root of that root by the product relation. Since lambda^3>2>p, the stated error and common entropy follow. Independent direct enumeration by bitwise products and individual flips agreed coefficient by coefficient with both polynomial formulas for N=3 to 14. value.rationale: The corrected result determines the exact energy-resolved number of strictly blocked physical states, not merely the admissible local words or the equilibrium partition function. This is a natural finite-size invariant for a classic metastable chain: commensurability removes entire physical sectors, and the signed transfer quantifies an exponentially growing subleading blocked-state term that does not change the known entropy. Neither a small exception nor a recomputation of the unrestricted formula is the surviving contribution.
residual_risks: The census does not predict frequencies of blocked configurations under a quench or positive-temperature escape rates.
